planets.name: TOI-663 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-663 with a 7.1-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-663 d was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-663. Its orbit and size follow Cointepas et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
